description: This file contains CMake functions for regex matching and replacement, including 'string_take_regex' and 'string_take_regex_replace', with comments and examples illustrating their usage and limitations.

methods.name: string_take_regex
methods.description: Performs regex matching at the beginning of a string and returns the match, modifying the input string by shortening it.

methods.name: string_take_regex_replace
methods.description: Uses 'string_take_regex' to match a pattern and then replaces the matched portion with a specified string, returning the match.
